action: include suitable and specific measures to safeguard the data subject's human dignity, legitimate interests and fundamental rights (transparency, transfers within groups, monitoring systems at work)

subject: controllers (processing for archiving, research or statistical purposes)
action: provide appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of the data subject, including technical and organisational measures for data minimisation (pseudonymisation where possible)

subject: Union or Member State law (legislator not named)
action: provide for derogations from Arts 15, 16, 18, 21 for scientific/historical research or statistical purposes, subject to the safeguards in 89(1)

subject: Union or Member State law (legislator not named)
action: provide for derogations from Arts 15, 16, 18, 19, 20, 21 for archiving purposes in the public interest, subject to the safeguards in 89(1)

subject: Member States
action: adopt specific rules setting out the powers of supervisory authorities under Art.58(1)(e),(f) in relation to controllers/processors subject to professional secrecy, where necessary and proportionate
conditions: rules apply only to personal data received or obtained in an activity covered by the secrecy obligation
note: National law can limit SA investigative powers over secrecy-bound controllers: a self-modifying dependency on the SA architecture (Chapter VI).

subject: churches and religious associations or communities (Member State)
action: continue to apply comprehensive data protection rules in place at entry into force, provided they are brought into line with the Regulation
conditions: comprehensive rules applied at entry into force; brought into line

subject: (Union legislator, by the provision itself)
action: confer on the Commission the power to adopt delegated acts, subject to the conditions of Art.92
norm_type: N1-like (direct conferral of a power, not of an entity)
note: Direct conferral of competence; effect from 24 May 2016 (92(2)) i.e. entry into force, earlier than the general application date (25 May 2018).

subject: European Commission
action: apply Article 5 of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011 (examination procedure) where reference is made to this paragraph
conditions: where reference is made to Art.93(2)

subject: European Commission
action: apply Article 8 in conjunction with Article 5 of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011 (immediately applicable implementing acts) where reference is made to this paragraph
conditions: where reference is made to Art.93(3)

subject: (interpretive rule)
action: construe references to Directive 95/46/EC as references to this Regulation, and references to the Working Party established by Art.29 of that Directive as references to the European Data Protection Board established by this Regulation
object: succession of the Working Party by the Board
note: Corroborates that the Board is 'established by this Regulation' (N1 at Art.68(1)).

subject: European Commission
action: examine in the reviews in particular the application and functioning of Chapter V (adequacy decisions) and Chapter VII (cooperation and consistency)
object: evaluation of Chapters V and VII

subject: European Commission
action: take into account the positions and findings of the European Parliament, the Council and other relevant bodies or sources

subject: European Commission
action: if necessary submit appropriate proposals to amend the Regulation, taking into account developments in information technology and the information society
conditions: if necessary

subject: European Commission
action: if appropriate submit legislative proposals to amend other Union legal acts on the protection of personal data, in particular for processing by Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies
conditions: if appropriate
depends_on: Regulation (EC) No 45/2001 and other Union acts

subject: (Regulation; temporal clause)
action: enter into force on the twentieth day following publication in the Official Journal
note: Publication 4 May 2016; the twentieth day following = 24 May 2016 (computed). Delegation in Art.92(2) and references in Arts 94, 96 use 24 May 2016.

subject: (Regulation; temporal clause)
action: apply from 25 May 2018
note: General application date; some provisions have dates of their own (Arts 51(4), 83(9), 84(2), 85(3), 88(3), 90(2): notifications by 25 May 2018; Art.92(2): 24 May 2016; Art.97(1): 25 May 2020).
